+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions"
+
+
+def request_speaker_diarization(audio_file_path: str, model: str = "gpt-4o-transcribe", language: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise EnvironmentError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    with open(audio_file_path, "rb") as audio_file:
+        files = {"file": audio_file}
+        data = {"model": model, "response_format": "verbose_json", "timestamp_granularities[]": ["segment"], "diarize": "true"}
+        if language:
+            data["language"] = language
+        response = requests.post(
+            OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_URL,
+            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"},
+            files=files,
+            data=data,
+            timeout=300,
+        )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()

import base64
import json
import os
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

import requests


def submit_transcription(audio_file_path: str, callback_url: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    api_key = os.environ.get("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise RuntimeError("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY is required")

    headers = {"authorization": api_key}
    with open(audio_file_path, "rb") as f:
        upload_resp = requests.post(
            "https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/upload",
            headers=headers,
            data=f,
            timeout=120,
        )
    upload_resp.raise_for_status()
    upload_url = upload_resp.json()["upload_url"]

    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "audio_url": upload_url,
        "speech_model": "best",
        "format_text": True,
    }
    if callback_url:
        payload["webhook_url"] = callback_url

    transcript_resp = requests.post(
        "https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/transcript",
        headers={**headers, "content-type": "application/json"},
        data=json.dumps(payload),
        timeout=120,
    )
    transcript_resp.raise_for_status()
    return transcript_resp.json()

+import os
+import time
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+def poll_transcription(transcript_id: str, poll_interval_seconds: float = 5.0, timeout_seconds: Optional[float] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    headers = {"authorization": api_key}
+    url = f"https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/transcript/{transcript_id}"
+    start = time.monotonic()
+
+    while True:
+        resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=120)
+        resp.raise_for_status()
+        data = resp.json()
+        status = data.get("status")
+
+        if status == "completed":
+            return data
+        if status == "error":
+            raise RuntimeError(data.get("error", "Transcription failed"))
+
+        if timeout_seconds is not None and (time.monotonic() - start) >= timeout_seconds:
+            raise TimeoutError("Timed out while polling transcription job")
+
+        time.sleep(poll_interval_seconds)
*** End Patch
